requirements.text: Upon accessing the application, the user should see the main title 'Number To Words Conversion' prominently displayed at the top of the page within an HTML element with the class 'heading'. This title should be visible immediately upon page load, ensuring that users can easily identify the purpose of the application without any additional interaction. The title should be styled according to the CSS rules associated with the 'heading' class, maintaining consistency with the overall design of the application.

The application provides a real-time number-to-words conversion feature. When a user enters a numeric value into the input field with data-testid 'input-box', the system validates the input and displays the corresponding word representation in the output paragraph with data-testid 'output-paragraph'. The input is padded with leading zeros until its length is divisible by 3 before conversion. If the user enters non-numeric characters, the system shows an error message 'Invalid input. Please enter only digits.' styled in red text. For numbers exceeding 15 digits, the system displays a 'Too Large Number.' error message, also in red. If the input is zero, the output displays 'Zero' in black text. For valid numbers with leading zeros, the leading zeros are ignored, and the number is correctly converted and shown in black text.

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Verify the main title is displayed correctly on page load
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Display Main Title on Application Load
  The application should display the heading "Number To Words Conversion" at the top of the page when the user accesses the application.


  Scenario: [Normal] Verify the main title is displayed correctly on page load
    Given the user accesses the application
    When the webpage is fully loaded
    Then the heading with class "heading" should display the text "Number To Words Conversion"

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Convert a valid number to words
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Real-time Number-to-Words Conversion
  The application provides a real-time number-to-words conversion feature. It validates user input and displays the corresponding word representation or an error message.


  Scenario: [Normal] Convert a valid number to words
    Given the "Number To Words Converter" page is loaded
    And the input field with data-testid "input-box" is empty
    When the user enters "123" into the input field with data-testid "input-box"
    Then the output paragraph with data-testid "output-paragraph" displays "One Hundred Twenty Three"
    And the text color of the output paragraph is black
